info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Analytics REST Change Events Platform Events API
Salesforce Sales Cloud Describe a platform event

params.name: eventApiName
params.description: The API name of the platform event (e.g., Order_Event__e)

items.docs: Retrieves metadata about the specified platform event including its fields, label, and API name. The event API name uses the __e suffix (e.g., Order_Event__e).

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Publish a platform event

params.name: eventApiName
params.description: The API name of the platform event (e.g., Order_Event__e)

items.docs: Publishes a single platform event message by inserting an sObject record for the event type. The event API name uses the __e suffix. Include the event's custom fields in the request body.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Get full platform event metadata

params.name: eventApiName
params.description: The API name of the platform event (e.g., Order_Event__e)

items.docs: Retrieves complete metadata about the specified platform event including all fields, their types, lengths, and other attributes.
